a: Ki zakki lehu rachamana – leyisrael, deit lehu lishka. lechohanim, delet lehu lishka – la zakki lehu rachamana, ka mashma lan.

Veetzim, difshita leh letanna demishshel tzibbur, menalan? detanya: yachol haomer "hare alay ola" yavi etzim mittoch beto, kederech shemmevi nesachim mittoch beto? talmud lomar: "al haetzim asher al haesh asher al hammizbeach" – ma mizbeach mishshel tzibbur, af etzim vaesh mishshel tzibbur, divre rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon.
Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: ma mizbeach – shello nishtammesh bo hedyot, af etzim vaesh – shello nishtammesh bahen hedyot. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu chadte.
Veattike la? vehachtiv: "vayyomer aravna el david yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech hattov beenav ree habbakar laola vehammoriggim uchele habbakar leetzim"! hacha name bechadte.

May "moriggim"? amar ulla: mitta shel tarbel. may mitta shel tarbel? amar rav yehuda: izza dekureksa dedashu ba dishtae. amar rav yosef: may keraa? "hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot tadush harim".
Mishna nitarev kumetzah bekometz chavertah, beminchat kohanim, beminchat kohen mashiach, beminchat nesachim – keshera.
Rabbi yehuda omer: beminchat kohen mashiach, beminchat nesachim – pesula, shezzo belilatah ava, vezo belilatah rakka, vehen bolot zo mizzo.

Gemara tenan hatam: dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam – kasher. nitarev beyayin – roin oto keillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam behema o bedam chayya – roin oto keillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer: en dam mevattel dam.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, "velakach middam happar umiddam hassair". haddavar yadua sheddamo shel par merubbe middamo shel sair. rabbanan savri:
b: Mikkan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze, verabbi yehuda savar: mikkan lemin bemino sheeno batel.
Rabbanan savri mikkan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze, vedilma mishshum demin bemino hu!
I ashmeinan min bemino, vela ashmeinan olin, kidka amrat. hasheta deashmeinan olin, mishshum deolin.
Vedilma ad deikka min bemino veolin? kashya.
Verabbi yehuda savar mikkan lemin bemino sheeno batel, vedilma mishshum deolin hu!
I ashmeinan olin min besheeno mino – kidkaamrat, hasheta deashmeinan min bemino – mishshum demin bemino hu.
Vedilma ad deikka min bemino veolin? kashya.

Tenan: rabbi yehuda omer: beminchat kohanim, beminchat kohen mashiach, uveminchat nesachim – pesula, shezzo belilatah ava vezo belilatah rakka, vehen bolot zo mizzo. vechi bolot zo mizzo ma have? min bemino hu!

a: Amar rava: kasavar rabbi yehuda, kol shehu min bemino vedavar acher – sallek et mino kemi sheeno, vesheeno mino rave alav umevattelo.
Ittemar: kometz deminchat chote sheshshimmeno, rabbi yochanan omer: pasul, veresh lakish amar: hu atzmo meshachshecho bishyare hallog umaalehu.
Vehachtiv: "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona"? hahu shello yikba lah shemen kechavroteha.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: charev shennitarev bevalul – yakriv, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yakriv. may lav, kometz deminchat chote deiarav bekometz deminchat nedava?
Lo, minchat parim veelim beminchat kevasim.
Veha behedya katane la: minchat parim veelim beminchat kevasim, vecharev shennitarev bevalul – yikrav, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yikrav. parushe kamfaresh la.
Bae rava: kometz shemmitztza shamno al gabbe etzim, mahu? chibbure olin keolin damu, o lav keolin damu? amar leh ravina lerav ashe: lav hayeynu derabbi yochanan veresh lakish?
Deittemar: hammaale ever sheen bo kezayit, veetzem mashlimo lichzayit – rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, resh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv, chibbure olin keolin damu, veresh lakish amar patur, chibbure olin lav keolin damu.
Tibbee lerabbi yochanan, vetibbee leresh lakish. tibbee lerabbi yochanan: ad kan la ka amar rabbi yochanan hatam, ella beetzem, demina devasar hu, aval hay delav demina dekometz hu – la.
O dilma, afillu leresh lakish la ka amar ella beetzem, devar mifrash hu, vei paresh – lav mitzva leahdore, aval shemen delav bar mifrash hu – la, o dilma la shena. teku.
Mishna shete menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bazo, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah – kesherot, veim lav – pesulot.
Kometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza – lo yaktir, veim hiktir – zo shennikmetza alat labbealim, vezo shello nikmetza lo alat labbealim.
Nitarev kumetzah bishyareha, o bishyareha shel chavertah – lo yaktir, veim hiktir – alat labbealim.
Gemara amar rav chisda: nevela betela bishchuta, shei efshar lishchuta shettease nevela.
Ushechuta enah betela binvela, sheefshar linvela shettease shechuta, dilchi masrecha parcha tumeatah.
Verabbi chanina amar: kol sheefshar lo lihyot kamohu – eno batel, vechol shei efshar lo lihyot kamohu – batel.
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbanan, ha amri: olin hu dela mevatteli ahadade, aval min bemino – batel.
I allibba derabbi yehuda, veha
b: Rabbi yehuda batar chazuta azel, veidde veidde min bemino hu.
Ella, allibba derabbi chiyyay, detane rabbi chiyyay: nevela ushechuta betelot zo bazo.
Rabbi chiyyay allibba deman? i allibba derabbanan – ha amri: olin hu dela mevatteli ahadade, ha min bemino batel! vei allibba derabbi yehuda – kol min bemino lerabbi yehuda lo batel!
Leolam allibba derabbi yehuda, vechi ka amar rabbi yehuda: min bemino lo batel – hane mille hecha deefshar leh lemihve kevavteh, aval hecha dela efshar leh lemihve kevavteh – batel.
Uveha ka mippalgi, derav chisda savar: batar mevattel azlinan.
Verabbi chanina savar: batar batel azlinan.

Tenan: shete menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bezo, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah – kesherot, veim lav – pesulot. veha hacha, kevan dekametz leh mechada – iddach hava leh shirayim, vela ka mevatteli shirayim letivla.
Manni? i rabbanan – ha amri: olin hu dela mevatteli hadade, ha min bemino batel! ella peshita – rabbi yehuda.
Bishlama leman deamar: batar batel azlinan, batel have kimvattel, dilchi kametz meiddach – havu lehu shirayim ki hane.
Ella leman deamar batar mevattel azlinan, shirayim mi ka havu tivla? lema allibba derav chisda, dela kerabbi chiyyay.
Hatam, kidrabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: neemra haketara bekometz, veneemra haketara beshirayim.
Ma haketara haamura bakkometz – en hakkometz mevattel et chavero, af haketara haamura bashshirayim – en shirayim mevattelin et hakkometz.
Ta shema: hakkometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza – lo yaktir, veim hiktir – zo shennikmetza alta labbealim, vezo shello nikmetza lo alta labbealim, vela ka mevattel leh tivla lekometz.
Manni? i rabbanan – ha amri: olin hu dela mevatteli hadade, ha min bemino betil! ella peshita – rabbi yehuda.
Bishlama leman deamar: batar mevattel azlinan, mevattel have kevatel, dechol pureta chaze lemikmatz minneh, vehave leh min umino, umin bemino lo batel.
Ella leman deamar batar batel azlinan, kometz mi ka have tivla? lema dela kerabbi chiyyay? ha name kidrabbi zera.
Ta shema: nitarev kumetzah beshirayim shel chavertah – lo yaktir, veim hiktir – alta labbealim. veha hacha dela have mevattel kevatel, vela ka mevatteli leh shirayim lekometz.
Manni? i rabbanan vechulei.

Amar rabbi zera: neemra haketara bakkometz, veneemra haketara bashshirayim, ma haketara haamura bakkometz – en kometz mevattel et chavero, af haketara haamura bashshirayim – en shirayim mevattelin et hakkometz.
Ta shema: tibbelah beketzach, beshumeshmin, uvechol mine tavlin – keshera. matztza hi, ella shennikret matztza metubbelet. ka salka datach deappesh la tavlin tefe mimmatztza.
Bishlama leman deamar batar batel azlinan, batel have kimvattel, dilchi miappesha (have) [havya] la ketavlin. ella leman deamar batar mevattel azlinan, tavlin mi ka havo matztza?
Hacha bemay askinan? dela appish la tavlin, derubba matztza hi, vela batla. dayka name, dekatane: matztza hi, ella shennikret matztza metubbelet, shema minna.
Ki selek rav kahana, ashkechinhu livne rabbi chiyyay deyatvi vekaamri: issaron shechilleko

a: Vehinnicho bevisa, venaga tevul yom beechad mehen, mahu? ki tenan: keli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, hane mille hecha denagi bahadade, aval hecha dela nagi bahadade – la, o dilma la shena?
Amar lehu ihu: mi tenan "keli mechabber"? "keli metzaref" tenan, kol dehu. hoshit echad levenehen – mahu?
Amar lehu: tzarich lichli – keli metzarfo, en tzarich lichli – en keli metzarfo.
Hoshit tevul yom et etzbao benehen, mahu? amar lehu: en lecha davar shemmetamme meaviro ella keli cheres bilvad.
Hadar ihu bea minnayyhu: mahu likmotz mizze al ze? tzeruf deorayyta o derabbanan?
Amru lo: zo lo shamanu, kayyotze bo shamanu, ditnan: shete menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bazo, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah – kesherot, veim lav – pesulot.
Ki yachol likmotz miha kesherot, ammay? hach dimarav ha la naga!
Amar rava: dilma begushshin hamechullakin haasuyin kemasrek.
May have ala? amar rava: ta shema, detanya: "veherim mimmennu" – min hamechubbar, shello yavi issaron bishne kelim veyikmotz. ha bichli echad dumeya dishne kelim – kametz.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma shene kelim hechi dame? kegon kefiza bekabba, deaf al gav daarivi meillay, kevan demippaskan mechitzata dikfiza mittatta.
Ha keli echad dumeya dishne kelim, hechi dame? kegon arevat tarnegolin, veaf al gav demippaskan mechitzata ha negia, aval hacha dela negia kelal – tibbee lach.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: tzeruf keli vechibbur mayim, mahu?
Ki tenan keli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, hane mille degavvay, aval devaray – la, o dilma, kevan dimchabbar – mechabbar.
Veim timtze lomar: kevan dimchabbar mechabbar, chibbur mayim vetzeruf keli, venaga tevul yom mibbachutz – mahu?
Ki tenan "keli metzaref", hane mille denaga miggavvay, aval mibbaray – la, o dilma la shena? teku.
Bae rava: issaron shechilleko, venitma echad mehen, vehinnicho bevisa, vechazar tevul yom venaga beoto tame – mahu? mi amrinan seva lo tumea, o la?
Amar leh abbaye: umi amrinan seva leh tumea? vehatnan: sadin tame
b: Midras vaasao vilon – tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras.
Amar rabbi yose: beeze midras naga ze? ella sheim naga bo hazzav, tame magga hazzav.
Ki naga bo hazzav miha tame, vaafillu levassof ketame midras, veachar kach magga hazzav, ammay? lema: seva leh tumea!
Amar leh: umimmay dehay "sheim naga bo hazzav" levatar midras? dilma mikkamme midras, dehavya tumea chamura al tumea kalla.
Aval hacha, deidde veidde tumea kalla – la.
Ella missefa, mode rabbi yose bishne sedinin hamekuppalin umunnachin ze al ze veyashav zav alehen, shehaelyon tame midras, vehattachton tame midras umagga midras. veammay? lema: seva leh tumea!
Hatam bevat achat, hacha beze achar ze.
Amar rava: issaron shechilleko, veavad echad mehen, vehifrish acher tachtav, venimtza harishon, vahare shelashtan munnachin bevisa – nitma avud, avud verishon mitztarfin, muferash en mitztaref.
Nitma muferash – muferash verishon mitztarfin, avud en mitztaref; nitma rishon – shenehem mitztarfin.
Abbaye amar: afillu nitma echad mehen name – shenehem mitztarfin, may tama? kullehu bene vikta dahadade ninhu.
Vechen leinyan kemitza, kamatz min haavud – sheyarav verishon neechalin, muferash eno neechol; kamatz min hammuferash – sheyarav verishon neechalin, avud eno neechol.
Kamatz min rishon – shenehem enan neechalin.
Abbaye amar: afillu kamatz meechad mehen, shenehen enan neechalin. may tama? kullehu name bene vikta dahadade ninhu.
Matkef la rav pappa: veshirayim dideh miha neechalin? ha ikka danka dekometz dela karev!
Matkef la rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: vekometz gufeh hechi karev? ha ikka telata chullin.
Rav ashe amar: kometz bedata dechohen talya milleta, vechohen ki kametz – aissaron ka kametz.

a: Mishna nitma hakkometz vehikrivo – hatztzitz meratztze, yatza vehikrivo – en hatztzitz meratztze, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze al hayyotze.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "venasa aharon et avon hakkodashim" – vechi eze avon hu nose? im tomar avon piggul – hare kevar neemar "lo yechashev"! im tomar avon notar – hare kevar neemar "lo yeratze"!
Ha eno nose ella avon tumea, shehuttera mikkelalah betzibbur.
Matkef la rabbi zera: ema avon yotze, shehuttar mikkelalo bevama.
Amar leh abbaye, amar kera: "leratzon lahem lifne Adonai", avon delifne Adonai – in, avon deyotze – la.
Matkef la rabbi ila: ema avon semol, shehuttar mikkelalo beyom hakkippurim.
Amar leh abbaye: amar kera "avon" – avon shehaya bo udechitiv, leappoke yom hakkippurim dehechshero bismol hu.
Rav ashe amar: "avon hakkodashim", velo "avon hammakdishin".

Amar leh rav sima bereh derav idi lerav ashe, veamri la rav sima bereh derav ashe lerav ashe: veema avon baal mum shehuttar mikkelalo beofot, deamar mar: tammut vezachrut bivhema, veen tammut vezachrut beofot!
Amar leh: alecha amar kera, "lo yeratze", "ki lo leratzon yihye lachem".

Tanu rabbanan: dam shennitma uzerako beshogeg – huretza, bemezid – lo huretza. bamme devarim amurim? beyachid, aval betzibbur, ben beshogeg ben bemezid – huretza, uvegoy, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon –
b: Lo huretza.
Vrminhi: al ma hatztzitz meratztze? al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, ben beyachid ben betzibbur.

Amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha rabbi yose, ha rabbanan. detanya: en tormin min hattame al hattahor, veim taram beshogeg – terumato teruma, bemezid – en terumato teruma. rabbi yose omer: ben beshogeg ben bemezid – terumato teruma.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yose dela kanes, dimratztze tzitz al achilot mi shamat leh? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer omer: hatztzitz meratztze al achilot, rabbi yose omer: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot.
Efoch: rabbi eliezer omer: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot, rabbi yose omer: hatztzitz meratztze al achilot.
Matkef la rav sheshet: umi matzet afchat la? vehatanya: yachol basar shennitma lifne zerikat damim yehu chayyayvin alehen mishshum tumea?
Talmud lomar: "kol tahor yochal basar", "vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai vetumato alav venichreta", hannittar lithorin chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea,
Vesheeno nittar lithorin, en chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea.
O eno ella: neechol lithorin – chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea, vesheeno neechol lithorin – en chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea, otzi ani et hallan veet hayyotze, sheenan neechalin lithorim.
Talmud lomar: "asher laAdonai" – ribba.
Yachol sheani merabbe et happiggulin veet hannotarot?
Notarot hayeynu lan, ella af happiggulin kannotarot? talmud lomar "mizzevach hashshelamim" – miet.
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu? achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, amarta: merabbe ani et ellu shehayta lahen sheat hakkosher, umotzi ani et ellu shello hayta lahen sheat hakkosher.
Veim tomar: basar shennitma lifne zerikat damim vaachalo leachar zerikat damim, mippene ma chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea? mippene shehatztzitz meratztze.
Nitma – in, yotze – la.
Man shamat leh deamar: "en zerika moelet layyotze"? rabbi eliezer, vekatane dimratztze tzitz al achilot.
Ella amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbanan.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi eliezer dimratztze tzitz al achilot, dela kanes mi shamat leh? in, ki hechi deshamat leh lerabbi yose, shamat leh lerabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: ben beshogeg ben bemezid terumato teruma.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi eliezer bitruma dekilla, bekadashim dachamiri mi shamat leh? im ken, ha amman tirmeyay?
Ravina amar: tumeato, ben beshogeg ben bemezid – huretza; zerikato, beshogeg – huretza, bemezid – lo huretza.
Verav shela amar: zerikato, ben beshogeg ben bemezid – huretza. tumeato, beshogeg – huretza, bemezid – lo huretza.
Ulerav shela, dekatane: shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid – hachi kaamar: nitma beshogeg uzerako, ben beshogeg ben bemezid.

a: Ta shema: dam shennitma uzerako beshogeg huretza, bemezid lo huretza – hachi kaamar: dam shennitma uzerako, ben beshogeg ben bemezid – nitma beshogeg huretza, bemezid lo huretza.
Mishna nitmeu sheyareha, nisrefu sheyareha, avdu sheyareha – kemiddat rabbi eliezer keshera, uchemiddat rabbi yehoshua pesula.
Gemara amar rav: vehu shennitmeu kol sheyareha, aval miktzat sheyareha – la.

Ka salka datach: nitma – in, avud vesaruf – la. may kasavar? i kasavar: shiyyura milleta hi – afillu avud vesaruf name! i kasavar: shiyyura lav milleta hi, venitma may tama – dimratztze tzitz? i hachi, kol sheyareha name!
Leolam kasavar: shiyyura milleta hi, venitma – vehu haddin leavud vesaruf, vehay dekaamar "nitma" – reshayyhu naket.
Kidtanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbetora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev – zorek et haddam.

Kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev – eno zorek et haddam, uvaola afillu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev – zorek et haddam, mippene shekkullah kalil, uvammincha afillu kullah kayyemet – lo yizrok.
Mincha may avidta? amar rav pappa: minchat nesachim, salka datach – hoil uvahade zevach ka atya, kegufeh dezivcha damya, ka mashma lan.
Menahane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael, umatu ba mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: amar kera "vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach laAdonai", chelev – veaf al pi sheen basar.
Veashkechan chelev, yoteret ushete kelayot menalan? dekatane: uvammincha, afillu kullah kayyemet lo yizrok. mincha hu delo yizrok, ha yoteret ushete kelayot – yizrok.
Menalan? rabbi yochanan dideh amar: "lereach nichoach" – kol sheatta maale lereach nichoach.

Veitzterich lemichtav "chelev", veitzterich lemichtav "lereach nichoach", dei ketav "chelev" hava amena: chelev – in, yoteret ushete kelayot – la, ketav rachamana "reach nichoach". vei ketav rachamana "lereach nichoach" hava amena: afillu mincha, ketav rachamana "chelev".
Mishna shello bichle sharet – pasul, verabbi shimon machshir. hiktir kumetzah paamayim – keshera.

Gemara amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: may tama derabbi shimon? amar kera "kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham". ba leovdah bayyad kechattat – ovdah beyamin, kechattat. bichli – ovdah bismol, keasham.
Verabbi yannay amar: kevan shekkematzo mikkele sharet, maalehu umaktiro afillu behemyayno, vaafillu bimkidda shel cheres. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: hakkol modim bakkometz shettaun kiddush.

Metivi: hekter chalavim veevarim veetzim sheheelan, ben bayyad ben bichli, ben beyamin uven bismol – kesherin; hakkometz vehakketoret vehallevona sheheelan, ben bayyad ben bichli, ben beyamin ben bismol – kesherin. teyuveta derabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay!
Amar lach rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: litzdadin katane – bayyad beyamin, bichli – ben beyamin ben bismol.
Ta shema: kematzo shello mikkele sharet, vekiddesho shello bichle sharet, veheelo vehiktiro shello bichli sharet – pasul, rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bemattan keli.
Ema: mimmattan keli veelach.

Ta shema: vachachamim omrim: kometz taun keli sharet, ketzad? komtzo mikkeli sharet, umekaddesho bichli sharet, umaalo umaktiro bichli sharet. rabbi shimon omer: kevan shekkematzo mikkeli sharet, maalo umaktiro shello bichli sharet vedayyo.
Ema: kevan shekkematzo vekiddesho bichli sharet, maalo umaktiro vedayyo.
Ta shema: kamatz bimino venatan bismolo – yachzir limino, bismolo
b: Vechishshev aleha ben chutz limkomo ben chutz lizmanno – pasul, veen bo karet.
(Lo) chishshev aleha chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet, divre rabbi elazar verabbi shimon.

Vachachamim omrim: kevan shennetano lismol – pesalattu mattenato, may tama? mishshum devae kedushsha bichli, vechevan shennetano lismol – naasa kedam shennishpach mitztzavvar behema al haritzpa vaasafo, sheppasul.
Mikkelal derabbi elazar verabbi shimon la bau mattan keli, teyuveta derav nachman, teyuveta.
Lerabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay mesayyeya leh, lerabbi yannay lema tehve teyuveta?
Amar lach rabbi yannay: ana daamari ketanna dehekter, velav litzdadim katane.
Hiktir kumetzah paamayim – keshera. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "paamayim" – velo paame faamayim, verabbi yochanan amar: "paamayim" – vaafillu paame faamayim.
May benayyhu? amar rabbi zera: yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim, veyesh haketara pechuta mikkezayit ikka benayyhu.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi savar: en kometz pachot mishshene zetim, veen haketara pechuta mikkezayit. verabbi yochanan savar: yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim, veyesh haketara pechuta mikkezayit.
Ittemar: kometz meematay mattir shirayim baachila? rabbi chanina omer: mishshemmashla bo (et) haur, rabbi yochanan amar: mishshettatztzit bo (et) haur berubbo.
Amar leh rav yehuda lerabba bar rav yitzchak: asbera lach tama derabbi yochanan, amar kera: "vehinne ala kitor haaretz kekitor hakkivshan", en kivshan maale kitor ad shettatztzit haur berubbo.

Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava: amri talmidecha amar rav amram, tanya: en li ella devarim sheddarkan likrav ballayla, kegon evarim ufedarim, shemmaalan umaktiran mibbo hashshemesh, umitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla kullah.
Devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom, kegon: hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashuach, uminchat nesachim, shemmaalan umaktiran mibbo hashshemesh?
Veha amrat darkan likrav bayyom! ella, im bo hashshemesh, shemmitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla – minnayin? talmud lomar: "zot torat haola" – ribba.
Veha im bo hashshemesh – la mashkachat la shettatztzit haur berubbo. la kashya: kan liklot, kan lehattir.
Rabbi elazar matne la "mibbo hashshemesh", umokem la befokin, vechen ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yannay: befokin.

Umi amar rabbi yannay hachi? veha amar rabbi yannay: ketoret sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach, afillu keratin shebbah en machazirin otan! vetane rav chanina bar minyome bidve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: "asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach" – ikkule ola atta machzir, vei atta machzir ikkule ketoret! semi mikkan ketoret.
Amar rabbi assi: ki pashet rabbi elazar bimnachot, bae hachi – bae rabbi elazar: kometz shessiddero, vesidder alav et hammaaracha, mahu? derech haketara bechach, o en derech haketara bechach? teku.

Bae chizkiyya: evarin shessidran vesidder alehen et hammaaracha, mahu? "al haetzim" amar rachmana davka al haetzim, o dilma kevan dichtiv kera acharina: "asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach", i bae hachi aved, i bae hachi aved? teku.
Bae rabbi yitzchak nappacha: evarin shessidderan betzidde hammaaracha, mahu? allibba deman deamar "al" mammash – la tibbee lach,

a: Deal haetzim ketiv.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba deman deamar "al" besamuch, may? hacha name "al" besamuch, o dilma "al haetzim" dumeya deal hammizbeach" – ma hatam al mammash, af hacha name al mammash? teku.
Mishna hakkometz miuto meakkev et rubbo, issaron miuto meakkev et rubbo, hayyayin miuto meakkev et rubbo, hashshemen miuto meakkev et rubbo.
Hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze, hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze.
Gemara may tama? amar kera "melo kumtzo" tere zimne.
Issaron miuto meakkev et rubbo, may tama? amar kera: "missoltah", sheim chasra kol shehu – pesula.
Hayyayin miuto meakkev et rubbo, "kacha".
Hashshemen miuto meakkev et rubbo, deminchat nesachim – "kacha", uminchat nedava – amar kera: "umishshamnah", sheim chasar kol shehu – pesula.
Hashshemen vehassolet meakkevin ze et ze, "missoltah umishshamnah", "miggirsah umishshamnah".
Hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze, "al kol levonatah", "veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha".
Mishna shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze, shene kivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze, shete challot meakkevot zo et zo.
Shene sedarin meakkevin ze et ze. shene bazichin meakkevin ze et ze. hassedarin vehabbazichin meakkevin ze et ze.
Shene minim shebbannazir, shelosha shebbappara, vearbaa shebbattoda, vearbaa shebballulav, (vearba) [vearbaa] shebbammetzora – meakkevin ze et ze.
Sheva hazzaot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo, sheva hazzayot sheal ben habbaddim, sheal happarochet, sheal mizbach hazzahav – meakkevot zo et zo.
Gemara shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze – chukka.
Shene kivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze – havaya, shete challot – havaya.
Shene sedarin – chukka, shene bazichin – chukka, hassedarin vehabbazichin – chukka.
Shene minim shebbannazir, dichtiv: "ken yaase", shelosha shebbappara – chukka.
Arbaa shebbattoda, deittakkash lenazir, dichtiv: "al zevach todat shelamav", veamar mar: "shelamav" – lerabbot shalme nazir.
Vearbaa shebbimtzora, dichtiv: "zot tihye torat hammetzora", vearbaa shebballulav – "ulekachtem", lekicha tamma.
Amar rav chanan bar rava: lo shanu ella sheen lo, aval yesh lo – en meakkevin.

Metivi: arbaa minin shebballulav, shenayim mehen osin perot, ushenayim mehem en osin perot; haosin perot yihyu zekukin lesheen osin, vesheen osin perot yihyu zekukin leosin perot, veen adam yotze yede chovato bahen ad sheyyehu kullan baagudda echat.
Vechen yisrael beharetzaa, ad sheyyehu kullan baagudda echat, shenneemar: "habbone vashshamayim maalotav vaaguddato al eretz yesadah".
Tannae hi, detanya: lulav ben agud ben sheeno agud – kasher; rabbi yehuda omer: agud – kasher, sheeno agud – pasul.
May tama derabbi yehuda? gamar kicha kicha meaguddat ezov",
Ma lehallan baagudda – af kan baagudda. verabbanan, la gamri "kicha kicha".
Keman azla ha detanya: lulav mitzva leogdo, veim lo agado – kasher? keman? i kerabbi yehuda, lo agado ammay kasher? i rabbanan, may mitzva?
Leolam rabbanan, umay mitzva? mishshum "ze eli veanvehu".
Sheva hazzaot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo – chukka.
Sheva hazzaot sheal ben habbaddim, vesheal mizbach hazzahav, vesheal happarochet – meakkevot zo et zo; deyom hakkippurim ketiv chukka.
Defar kohen mashuach, udefar helem davar shel tzibbur, vedisire avoda zara – kidtanya: "veasa lappar kaasher asa lefar", ma talmud lomar? lichpol behazzaot,
b: Sheim chisser achat min hammattanot lo asa kelum.
Tanu rabbanan: sheva hazzaot shebbappara, sheasaan – ben shello lishman, ben shello mechvvavnot el nochach pene ohel moed – pesulot.
Veshebbifnim, veshebbimtzora – shello lishman, pesulot; shello mechvvavnot, kesherot.
Vehatanya gabbe para: shello lishman – pesulot, shello mechvvavnot – kesherot. amar rav chisda: la kashya, ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbanan.
Detanya: mechussere chappara shennichnesu laazara beshogeg – chayyayv chattat, bemezid – anush karet, veen tzarich lomar tevul yom ushear kol hattemeim.

Utehorim shennichnesu lifnim mimmechitzatan, lahechol kullo – bearbaim, mibbet lapparochet el pene hakkapporet – bemita. rabbi yehuda omer: kol hechol kullo umibbet lapparochet – bearbaim, veel pene hakkapporet – bemita.

Bemay ka mippalgi? behay kera: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh mibbet lapparochet el pene hakkapporet asher al haaron velo yamut". rabbanan savri: "el hakkodesh" – belo yavo", "mibbet lapparochet" veel pene hakkapporet" – belo yamut".
Verabbi yehuda savar: "el hakkodesh" umibbet lapparochet" – belo yavo", veel pene hakkapporet" – belo yamut".

May tama derabbanan? i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi yehuda, lichtov rachamana "el hakkodesh" veel pene hakkapporet", vela bae "mibbet lapparochet", vaana amena: hechol michayyayv, mibbet lapparochet mibbaya? "mibbet happarochet" dichtav rachamana lema li? shema minna bemita.

Verabbi yehuda: i ketav rachamana "el hakkodesh" vela ketav "mibbet lapparochet", hava amena: may kodesh – mibbet lapparochet, aval hechol lav name la. verabbanan: hahu la matzet amrat, dehechol kullo ikkeri "kodesh", shenneemar: "vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim".

Verabbi yehuda may tama? i salka datach kidka amri rabbanan, lichtov rachamana "el hakkodesh" umibbet lapparochet", vela bae "el pene hakkapporet", vaana amena: "mibbet lapparochet" bemita, "el pene hakkapporet" mibbaya? "el pene hakkapporet" dichtav rachamana lema li? shema minna: "el pene hakkapporet" bemita, "mibbet lapparochet" beazhara.
Verabbanan? [in] hachi name dela tzerich, vehay dichtav rachamana "el pene hakkapporet" lemaote derech meshuppash.
Kidtana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: "el pene hakkapporet kedma" – ze bana av, kol makom shenneemar "pene" eno ella pene kadim.
Verabbi yehuda, lema kera "pene", may "el"? shema minna "el" davka, verabbanan – "el" lav davka.
Verabbi yehuda, deamar "el pene hakkapporet" davka, vehizza el nochach" name davka.
Verabbanan: middehatam lav davka, hacha name lav davka.
Matkef la rav yosef lerabbi yehuda: middeel" davka, (el nochach) [al] name davka? ella demikdash sheni dela havo aron vechapporet, hachi name dela aved hazzaot?
Amar rabba bar ulla, amar kera: "vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh" – mekom hamekuddash lakkodesh.
Rava amar: ha veha rabbanan,

a: Ha dekae mizrach umaarav veaddi, ha dekae tzafon vedarom veaddi.
Amar mar: veshebbifnim veshebbimtzora, shello lishman – pesulot, shello mechvvavnot – kesherot. vehatanya: ben shello lishman ben shello mechvvavnot – kesherot!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha rabbi eliezer veha rabbanan. rabbi eliezer demakkesh asham lechattat – makkesh name log leasham, rabbanan la makkeshi.
Ulerabbi eliezer, vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh?
Ella amar rava: ha veha rabbanan, kan lehacheshir hakkorban, kan leharetzot, shello alu labbealim leshum chova.
Mishna shiva kene menora meakkevin ze et ze, shiva neroteha meakkevin ze et ze, shete parashiyyot shebbammezuza meakkevot zo et zo, afillu ketav echad meakkevan.
Arba parashiyyot shebbattefillin meakkevin zo et zo, afillu ketav echad meakkevan. arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo, shearbatan mitzva achat. rabbi yishmael omer: arbatan arba mitzvot.
Gemara may tama? havaya ketiv behu.

Tanu rabbanan: menora hayta baa min haeshet umin hazzahav. asaah min haggerutaot – pesula, mishshear mine mattachot – keshera. may shena min haggerutaot pesula? dichtiv "miksha" vahavaya, shear mine mattachot name zahav vahavaya!
Amar kera "tease", lerabbot shear mine mattachot. veema lerabbot gerutaot? la salka datach, deammiksha" ketiva havaya.
"Tease" name ammiksha" ketiv, "miksha" "miksha" leakkev.
"Zahav" "zahav" name leakkev!

Hay may? i amrat bishlama min haggerutaot pesula, mishshear mine mattachot keshera – hayeynu "zahav" "zahav" "miksha" "miksha" lidrasha. ella i amrat min haggerutaot keshera, mishshear mine mattachot pesula – "zahav" "zahav" "miksha" "miksha" may darshat beh?

May derasha? detanya: "kikkar zahav tahor yaase otah et kol hakkelim haelle" – baa zahav, baa kikkar; enah baa zahav, enah baa kikkar. "gevieha kaftoreha uferacheha" – baa zahav, baa geviim kaftorim uferachim; enah baa zahav, enah baa geviim kaftorim uferachim.
Veema name: baa zahav – baa kanim, enah baa zahav – enah baa kanim? hahu pamot mikkere.
"Veze maase hammenora miksha zahav" – baa zahav, baa miksha; enah baa zahav, enah baa miksha.
"Miksha" desefa lemay ata? lemaote chatzotzrot, detanya: chatzotzrot hayu baim min haeshet, min hakkesef. asaam min haggerutaot – kesherim, mishshear mine mattachot – pesulim.
Umay shena mishshear mine mattachot pesulim, dichtiv "kesef" vahavaya, min haggerutaot name "miksha" vahavaya? miet rachamana gabbe menora "miksha hi" – "hi", vela chatzotzrot.
Tanu rabbanan: kol hakkelim
b: Sheasa moshe, kesherim lo uchesherim ledorot. chatzotzrot, kesherot lo ufesulot ledorot.
Chatzotzrot may tama? ilema deamar kera "ase lecha", lecha velo ledorot, ella meatta "veasita lecha aron etz", hachi name dilcha velo ledorot?

Ella, i leman deamar: "lecha" – mishshellecha, i leman deamar: kivyachol beshellecha ani rotze yoter mishshellahem, hay name mibbee leh lehachi. shane hatam, deamar kera "lecha" "lecha" tere zimne: "ase lecha" "vehayu lecha".

Tane rav pappa bereh derav chanin kammeh derav yosef: menora hayta baa min haeshet min hazzahav, asaah shel kesef – keshera, shel baatz veshel avar veshel gisteron – rabbi posel verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir, shel etz veshel etzem veshel zechuchit – divre hakkol pesula.
Amar leh: may datach? amar leh: ben mar uven mar kelale uferate darshi.
Mihu, mar savar: ma happerat meforash shel mattechet – af kol shel mattechet, umar savar: ma happerat meforash davar chashuv – af kol davar chashuv. amar leh: semi didach mikkamme didi.
Detanya: kele sharet sheasaan shel etz, rabbi posel, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir. bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi daresh kelale uferate, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribbuye umiute.

Rabbi daresh kelale uferate, "veasita menorat" – kalal, "zahav tahor" – parat, "miksha tease hammenora" – chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash shel mattechet, af kol shel mattechet.

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribbuye umiute: "veasita menorat" – ribba, "zahav tahor" – miet, "miksha tease hammenora" – chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol, umay rabbi? rabbi kol mille, umay mayet? mayet shel cheres.

Adderabba, semi didach mikkamme didi! la salka datach, detanya: en lo zahav mevi af shel kesef, shel nechoshet, shel barzel, veshel bedil, veshel oferet. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir af beshel etz.

Vetanya iddach: lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechol, achsadra keneged ulam, chatzer keneged azara, shulchan keneged shulchan, menora keneged menora, aval ose hu shel chamishsha veshel shishsha veshel shemona, veshel shiva lo yaase, vaafillu mishshear mine mattachot.

Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer: af shel etz lo yaase, kederech sheasu malche bet chashmonay. amru lo: mishsham reaya? shappudim shel barzel hayu, vechippum bevaatz. heeshiru – asaum shel kesef, chazru veheeshiru – asaum shel zahav.

Amar shemuel mishshemeh desava: govhah shel menora shemona asar tefachim, haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim, vetifchayim chalak, vetefach shebbo gevia vechaftor vaferach, vetifchayim chalak, vetefach kaftor.

Ushene kanim yotzin mimmennu, echad elach veechad elach, venimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora, vetefach chalak, vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzin mimmennu, echad elach veechad elach, nimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora, vetefach chalak, vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzin mimmennu, echad elach veechad elach, venimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora, vetifchayim chalak, nishtayyeyru sham shelosha tefachim shebbahen shelosha geviin vechaftor vaferach.

Ugeviin lema hen domin? kemin kosot alekkesanderiyyim, kaftorim lema hen domin? kemin tappuche hakkeretiyyim, perachim lema hen domin? kemin pirche haammudin, venimtzeu geviin esrim ushenayim, kaftorim achad asar, perachim tisha.
Geviim meakkevin ze et ze, kaftorim meakkevin ze et ze, perachim meakkevin ze et ze, geviim kaftorim uferachim meakkevin ze et ze.
Bishlama geviim esrim ushenayim, dichtiv: "uvammenora arbaa geviim vegomer", uchetiv: "shelosha geviim meshukkadim bakkane haechad kaftor vaferach vegomer", arbea dida

a: Vetamne sere dekanim, ha esrin vetarten. kaftorin name achad asar kaftorin: tere dida, veshishsha dekanim, vechaftor vechaftor vechaftor, ha chad sar.
Ella perachim tisha menalan? perachim tere dida, veshishsha dekanim – temanya havu! amar rav shalman: ketiv "ad yerechah ad pirchah miksha hi".
Amar rav: govhah shel menora tisha tefachim. etiveh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: even hayta lifne menora uvah shalosh maalot, shealeha hakkohen omed umetiv et hannerot.
Amar leh: shimi at? ki kaamena missefat kanim ulemala.

Ketiv: "vehapperach vehannerot vehammelkachayim zahav hu michlot zahav". may "michlot zahav"? amar rav amme: shekkillattu lechol zahav sagur shel shelomo, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: eser menorot asa shelomo, vechol achat veachat hevi lah elef kikkar zahav, vehichnisuhu elef peamim lechor, veheemiduhu al kikkar.
Ini? vehachtiv: "vechol kele mashke hammelech shelomo zahav vechol kele bet yaar hallevanon zahav sagur en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma"! zahav sagur ka amrinan.

Umi chasar kulle hay? vehatanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: maase vehayta [menorat] bet hammikdash yetera al shel moshe bedinar zahav kuredyakeni, vehichnisuha shemonim peamim lechor, veheemiduha al kikkar. kevan dekae kae.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "al hammenora hattehora", sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora. ella meatta, "al hashshulchan hattahor" sheyyardu maasav mimmakom tahor? ella tahor – mikkelal shehu tame, hacha name tehora – mikkelal shehi temea.

Bishlama hatam, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "al hashshulchan hattahor", mikkelal shehu tame? keli etz heasuy lenachat hu, vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tumea! ella melammed shemmagbihin oto leole regalim, umarim lahem lechem happanim, veomer lahem: reu chibbatchem lifne hammakom.
May chibbatchem? kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nes gadol naasa belechem happanim, silluko kesidduro, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".
Ella hacha, "tehora" mikkelal shehi temea? peshita, kele mattachot ninhu, uchele mattachot mekabbelin tumea! ella, sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora.
Tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: aron shel esh veshulchan shel esh umenora shel esh yardu min hashshamayim, veraa moshe veasa kemotam, shenneemar: "uree vaase ketavnitam asher atta more bahar".
Ella meatta, "vahakemota et hammishkan kemishpato asher horeta bahar", hachi name? hacha ketiv "kemishpato", hatam ketiv "ketavnitam".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: gavriel chagur kemin pesikya haya, vehera lo lemoshe maase menora, dichtiv: "veze maase hammenora".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: shelosha devarim hayu kashin lo lemoshe, ad shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu beetzbao, veellu hen: menora, verosh chodesh, usheratzim. menora – dichtiv: "veze maase hammenora", rosh chodesh – dichtiv: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim", sheratzim – dichtiv: "veze lachem hattame". veyesh omrim: af hilchot shechita, shenneemar: "veze asher taase al hammizbeach".
Shete parashiyyot shebbammezuza meakkevot zo et zo, vaafillu ketav echad meakkevan. peshita!

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: lo nitzrecha ella lekotzah shel yod. veha name peshita! ella lichiddach derav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ot sheen gevil mukkaf lah mearba ruchoteha – pesula.

Amar ashyan bar nadbach mishshemeh derav yehuda: nikkav tocho shel he kasher, yerecho pasul. amar rabbi zera: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav huna, verabbi yaakov amar: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav yehuda: nikkav tocho shel he kasher, yerecho – im nishtayyer bo keshiur ot ketanna kasher, veim lav – pasul.
Agra chamu derabbi abba,
b: Ippesika leh kara dehe dehaam" benikba, ata lekammeh derabbi abba. amar leh: im (mishtayyayr) [nishtayyer] bo keshiur ot ketanna – kasher, veim lav – pasul.

Rame bar tamre, dehu chamu derame bar dikkule, ippesika leh kara devav devayaharog" benikba, ata lekammeh derabbi zera. amar leh: zil ayyti yanoka dela chakkim vela tippesh – i kare leh "vayyaharog" kasher, i la – "yehareg" hu, ufasul.

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: beshaa sheala moshe lammarom, metzao lehakkadosh baruch hu sheyyoshev vekosher ketarim laotiyyot, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi meakkev al yadecha? amar lo: adam echad yesh sheatid lihyot besof kamma dorot vaakiva ben yosef shemo, sheatid lidrosh al kol kotz vakotz tillin tillin shel halachot.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hareehu li, amar lo: chazor laachorecha. halach veyashav besof shemone shurot, velo haya yodea ma hen omrim, tashash kocho. kevan shehiggia ledavar echad, amru lo talmidav: rabbi, minnayin lach? amar lahen: "halacha lemoshe missinay", nityayshsheva dato.

Chazar uva lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yesh lecha adam kaze veatta noten tora al yadi? amar lo: shetok, kach ala bemachshava lefanay. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hiritani torato, hareeni secharo. amar lo: chazor. chazar laachorav, raa sheshshoklin besaro bemakolin. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, zo tora vezo secharah? amar lo: shetok, kach ala bemachshava lefanay.
Amar rava: shevao otiyyot tzerichot shelosha ziyyunin, veellu hen: 436 93. amar rav ashe: chazena lehu lesafre davvkane deve rav, dechatri lehu legaggeh dechet, vetalu leh lechareh dehe.

Chotri lehu legaggeh dechet, kelomar: chay hu berumo shel olam, vetalu leh lechareh dehe, kediva minneh rabbi yehuda nesia merabbi amme: may dichtiv "bitchu bayya ade ad ki beyah Adonai tzur olamim"? amar leh: kol hattole bitchono behakkadosh baruch hu hare lo machse baolam hazze velaolam habba.
Amar leh: ana hachi ka kashya li, may shena dichtiv "beyah" vela ketiv "yah"?

Kiddaresh rabbi yehuda bar rabbi ilay: ellu shene olamot shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu, echad behe veechad beYod, veeni yodea im haolam habba beYod vehaolam hazze behe, im haolam hazze beYod vehaolam habba behe.
Keshehu omer: "elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram", al tikre "behibbaram" ella: behe beraam.
Umippene ma nivra haolam hazze behe? mippene sheddome leachsadra, shekkol harotze latzet yetze. umay tama talya kareh? dei hadar bitshuva meayyeyli leh.

Veliayyel behach, la mistayyeya milleta, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen"? ba littaher – mesayyeyin oto, ba littamme – potchin lo. umay tama it leh taga? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: im chozer – ani kosher lo kesher.
Mippene ma nivra haolam habba beYod? mippene shetztzaddikim shebbo muatim. umippene ma kafuf rosho? mippene shetztzaddikim shebbo kafuf rashehem mippene maasehen, sheenan domin ze laze.
Amar rav yosef: hane tarte mille amar rav bisfarim, vetanya teyuveteh. chada, ha deamar rav: sefer tora sheyyesh bo shete taiyyot bechol daf vadaf – yetakken, shalosh – yigganez.

Vetanya teyuveteh: shalosh – yetakken, arba – yigganez. tana: im yesh bo daf achat shelema – matztzelet al kullo. amar rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: vehu dichtiv rubbeh desifra shappir.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: i it behahu daf shalosh taiyyot, may? amar leh: hoil veityehev leittekone mittekan. vehane mille chaserot, aval yeterot let lan ba. chaserot may tama la? amar rav kahana: mishshum demichaze kimnummar.
Agra chamu derabbi abba hava leh yeterot besifreh, ata lekammeh derabbi abba, amar leh: la amaran ella bachaserot,

a: Aval yeterot let lan ba.

Iddach, deamar rav: hakkotev sefer tora uva ligmor – gomer, vaafillu beemtza haddaf. metivi: hakkotev sefer tora, ba lo ligmor – lo yigmor baemtza haddaf kederech sheggomer bachummashin, ella mekatztzer veholech ad sof haddaf! ki ka amar rav – bechummashin.
Veha sefer tora kaamar? bechummashin shel sefer tora. ini? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua bar abba amar rav giddel amar rav: "leene kol yisrael" beemtza haddaf? hahi beemtza shita ittemar.
Rabbanan amri: af beemtza shita, rav ashe amar: beemtza shita davvka, vehilcheta: beemtza shita davvka.
Amar rabbi yehoshua bar abba, amar rav giddel, amar rav: shemona pesukim shebbattora, yachid kore otan bevet hakkeneset. keman? dela kerabbi shimon.

Detanya: "vayyamot sham moshe eved Adonai", efshar moshe chay vechatav "vayyamot sham moshe"? ella ad kan katav moshe, mikkan veelach katav yehoshua bin nun, divre rabbi yehuda, veamri la rabbi nechemya.
Amar lo rabbi shimon: efshar sefer tora chaser ot achat? uchetiv "lakoach et sefer hattora hazze vesamtem oto vegomer".

Ella, ad kan – hakkadosh baruch hu omer umoshe kotev veomer, mikkan veelach – hakkadosh baruch hu omer umoshe kotev bedema, kema shenneemar lehallan: "vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et kol haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al hassefer baddeyo".
Lema dela kerabbi shimon? afillu tema rabbi shimon, hoil veishtanni – ishtanni.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua bar abba, amar rav giddel, amar rav: hallokeach sefer tora min hashshuk – kechotef mitzva min hashshuk, ketavo – maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbelo mehar sinay. amar rav sheshet: im higgiah afillu ot achat – maale alav keillu ketavo.
(Siman 133) tanu rabbanan: ose adam yeria mibbat shalosh dappin vead bat shemona dappin, pachot mikken veyater al ken lo yaase.
Velo yarbe bedappin, mippene shennire iggeret, velo yemaet bedappin, mippene sheenav meshottot, ella kegon "lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem" shalosh peamim.
Nizdammena lo yeria bat tesha dappim, lo yachlok shalosh lechan veshesh lechan, ella arba lechan vechamesh lechan.
Bamme devarim amurim? bitchillat hassefer, aval besof hassefer – afillu pasuk echad vaafillu daf echad. pasuk echad salka datach? ella ema: pasuk echad bedaf echad.

Shiur gillayon millematta – tefach, millemala – shalosh etzbaot, uven daf ledaf – kimlo revach rochav shete etzbaot, uvachummashin millematta – shalosh etzbaot, millemala – shete etzbaot, uven daf ledaf – kimlo revach rochav gudal.
Uven shita leshita kimlo shita, uven teva leteva kimlo ot ketanna, uven ot leot kimlo chut hassaara.
Al yemaet adam et hakketav, lo mippene revach shel matta, velo mippene revach shel mala, velo mippene revach shebben shita leshita, velo mippene revach shebben parasha lefarasha.
Nizdammena lo teva bat chamesh otiyyot – lo yichtov shetayim betoch haddaf veshalosh chutz laddaf,
b: Ella shalosh betoch haddaf ushetayim chutz laddaf. nizdammena lo teva bat shete otiyyot – lo yizrekenna leven haddappin, ella chozer vechotev bitchillat hashshita.

Hattoe bashshem, gorer et ma shekkatav, vetole et ma sheggarar, vechotev et hashshem al mekom haggerar, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: af tolin et hashshem. rabbi yitzchak omer: af mochek vechotev.

Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: kol hashshem kullo tolin, miktzato en tolin. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: en kotvin et hashshem lo al mekom haggerar velo al mekom hammechak, veen tolin oto. ketzad ose? mesallek et hayeria kullah vegonzah.
Ittemar: rav chananel amar rav, halacha: tolin et hashshem. rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel, halacha: mochek vechotev.
Velema mar halacha kemar, umar halacha kemar, mishshum deafchi lehu.
Amar ravin bar chinnana, amar ulla, amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, velo od, ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi shimon shezuri, halacha kemoto.

Aheyay? illema aha: rabbi shimon shezuri omer kol hashshem kullo tolin, miktzato en tolin – veha ittemar ala, amar rav chananel amar rav: halacha tolin et hashshem, verabba bar bar chana amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel: halacha mochek vechotev.
Veim ita, hu name lema.
Ella aha: rabbi shimon shezuri omer afillu ben chamesh shanim vechoresh bassade – shechitat immo metaharto.
Ha ittemar ala, zeeri amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, veim ita – hu name lema.
Ella aha: barishona hayu omrim hayyotze bekolar veamar "kitvu get leishti", hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar: af hamefaresh vehayyotze bishyayra. rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af hamesukkan.
I name aha: terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah, rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af bachol shoalo veochlo al piv.
Veha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan uvitrumat maaser shel demay, veim ita – hu name lema.

Ella aha: rabbi yose ben kippar omer mishshum rabbi shimon shezuri: pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera, miktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana umiktzato achar rosh hashshana – en tormin mizze al ze, lefi sheen tormin umeasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash.
Ketzad yaase, tzover gorno letocho, venimtza torem umeasser min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo, umin hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, veim ita – hu name lema.
Ella amar rav pappa: ashshidda, rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ayyayin, rav pappa amar:

a: Ashshidda, ditnan: bet shammay omrim nimdedet mibbifnim, uvet hillel omrim mibbachutz, umodim ellu veellu sheen ovi haraglayim veovi hallevizbezin nimdad.
Rabbi yose omer: modim sheovi haraglayim veovi hallevizbezin nimdad, uvenehen en nimdad. rabbi shimon shezuri omer: im hayu raglayim gevohot tefach – en benehen nimdad, veim lav – benehen nimdad.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ayyayin, ditnan: rabbi meir omer: shemen techilla leolam, vachachamim omrim: af haddevash, rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af hayyayin. mikkelal detanna kamma savar yayin la? ema: rabbi shimon shezuri omer: yayin.
Tanya, amar rabbi shimon shezuri: paam achat nitarev li tevel bechullin, uvati veshaalti et rabbi tarfon, veamar li: lech kach lecha min hashshuk veasser alav.
Kasavar deorayyta berubba batel, verov amme haaretz measserim hen, vehave leh ketorem min happetur al happetur.
Velema leh: "lech kach min haggoy", kasavar: en kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser, vehave leh min hachiyyuv al happetur.
Ikka deamri, amar leh: "lech kach min haggoy", kasavar yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser, vehave leh min happetur al happetur.
Velema leh: "kach mehashshuk", kasavar: en rov amme haaretz measserin.

Shelach leh rav yemar bar shelemya lerav pappa: ha deamar ravin bar chinnana amar ulla amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, velo od, ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi shimon shezuri halacha kemoto, af benitarev leh tevel bechullin?
Amar leh: in, amar rav ashe: amar li mar zutera, kashe ba rabbi chanina missura: peshita!
b: Mi kaamar bemishnatenu? "kol makom sheshshana" kaamar.

Amar rav zeera, amar rav chananel, amar rav: kera habba bishne shitin – yitpor, beshalosh – al yitpor. amar leh rabba zute lerav ashe: hachi amar rabbi yirmeya middifti mishshemeh derava, ha deamrinan "beshalosh al yitpor" – la amaran ella beattikata, aval chadtata – let lan ba.
Vela attikata attikata mammash, vela chadtata chadtata mammash, ella ha dela afitzan, ha daafitzan, vehane mille begidin, aval bigradin – la.
Bae rav yehuda bar abba: ben daf ledaf, ben shita leshita, may? teku.

Amar rabbi zeeri, amar rav chananel, amar rav: mezuza shekketavah shetayim shetayim, keshera. ibbaya lehu: shetayim veshalosh veachat, mahu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kol shekken sheasaah keshira. metivi: asaah keshira, o shira kemotah – pesula! ki tanya hahi besefer tora.

Ittemar name: amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rav acha bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mezuza sheasaah shetayim veshalosh veachat – keshera, uvilvad shello yaasenna kekubba, uvilvad shello yaasenna kezanav.
Amar rav chisda: "al haaretz" beshita acharona, ikka deamri: besof shita, veikka deamri: bitchillat shita.
Man deamar besof shita, chigvoah shamayim al haaretz", uman deamar bitchillat shita, ki hechi dimrachaka shamayim meeretz.
Amar rabbi chelbo: chazena leh lerav huna decharech la meechad" kelappe "shema", veose parashiyyoteha setumot.
Metivi: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: rabbi meir haya kotvah al duchesusetos kemin daf,

a: Veose revach millemala verevach millematta, veose parashiyyoteha petuchot. amarti lo: rabbi, ma taam? amar li: hoil veen semuchot min hattora.
Veamar rav chananel, amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar, may lav appetuchot?
La, arevach. vechamma revach? amar rav menashsheya bar yaakov, veamri la amar rav shemuel bar yaakov: kimle atba desifre.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: veat la tisbera dechi amar rav arevach, veha rav it leh minhaga, vehaiddana nehug alma bistumot!
Deamar rabba, amar rav kahana, amar rav: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar choltzin beminal – shomin lo, en choltzin besandal – en shomin lo, shekkevar nahagu haam besandal.
Verav yosef amar rav kahana, amar rav: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar en choltzin beminal – shomin lo, en choltzin besandal – en shomin lo, shekkevar nahagu haam besandal.
Veamrinan: may benayyhu? minal lechattechilla ikka benayyhu, ella lav shema minna arevach? shema minna.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mitzva laasotan setumot, vei avdinhu petuchot – shappir dame, umay petuchot dekaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar – af petuchot.
Lema mesayyay leh, kayyotze bo: sefer tora shebbala utefillin shebbalu – en osin mehen mezuza, lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla. ha moridin – osin.
Ammay? hacha setumot vehacha petuchot! dilma lehashelim.
Ha moridin osin? vehatanya: halacha lemoshe missinay – tefillin al hakkelaf, umezuza al duchesusetos; kelaf bimkom basar, duchesusetos bimkom sear! lemitzva.
Vehatanya: shinna pasul bitfillin! vehatanya: shinna ben baze uven beze pasul! idde veidde bitfillin, veha dechatvinhu akkelaf bimkom sear, veha
b: Dechatvinhu adduchesusetos bimkom basar.
Veibbaet ema: shinna baze uvaze tannae hi, detanya: shinna baze uvaze – pasul, rabbi [acha machshir mishshum rabbi] achay berabbi chanina, veamri la mishshemeh derabbi akiva berabbi chanina.

Ha moridin osin – veha baaya sirtut, deamar rav minyome bar chilkiyya, amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: kol mezuza sheenah mesuretetet pesula, verav minyamin bar chilkiyya dideh amar: sirtut shel mezuza halacha lemoshe missinay.
Tannae hi, detanya: rabbi yirmeya omer mishshum rabbenu: tefillin umezuzot nichtavot shello min hakketav, veen tzerichot sirtut.
Vehilcheta: tefillin la bae sirtut, umezuza baaya sirtut, veidde veidde nichtavot shello min hakketav. may tama? migras gerisin.

Amar rav chelbo: ana chazeteh lerav huna, dahava yatev appureya desefer tora aleh, vechaf lechadda aara, veannach aleh sefer tora, vahadar yetev bemitta. kasavar: asur leshev al gabbe mitta shessefer tora munnach aleha.

Ufeliga derabba bar bar chana, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: muttar leshev al gabbe mitta shessefer tora munnach aleha. veim lechashcha adam lomar: maase berabbi elazar shehaya yoshev al hammitta venizkar shessefer tora munnach aleha, venishmat veyashav al gabbe karka, vedome kemi shehikkisho nachash – hatam sefer tora al gabbe karka hava.
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: ketavah iggeret – pesula. may tama? atya "ketiva" "ketiva" missefer.
Veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: telaah bemakkel – pesula. may tama? "bisharecha" baenan. tanya name hachi: telaah bemakkel, o shehinnichah achar haddelet – sakkana veen bah mitzva.
Shel bet monbaz hammelech hayu osin befunedkotehen ken, zecher limzuza.
Veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: mitzva lehannichah betoch chalalo shel petach. peshita, "bisharecha" amar rachamana! salka datach amena, hoil veamar rava: mitzva lehannichah

a: Betefach hassamuch lirshut harabbim, kamma dimrachak mealle, ka mashma lan.
Veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: ketavah al shene dappin – pesula. metivi: ketavah al shene dappin vehinnicha bishne sippin – pesula, ha besaf echad – keshera! reuya lishne sippin kaamar.
Veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: bimzuza, hallech achar hekker tzir. may hekker tzir? amar rav adda: avakta. hechi dame? kegon pitcha deven tere batte, ben be gavre leve neshe.
Resh galuta bena beta, amar leh lerav nachman: "keva li mezuzeta", amar rav nachman: "teli dashshe beresha".

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: asaah kemin neger – pesula. ini? veha ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar: kullehu mezuzata deve rabbi kemin neger havo avidan, vehahi pitcha deayel beh rabbi leve midresha la hava la mezuza! la kashya: ha daavida kesikketa, ha daavida keistavira.
Ini? veha hahu pitcha dahava ayel ba rav huna leve midresha, vehaveya le mezuza! hahu regil hava, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: bimzuza hallech achar haragil.

Amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar shemuel: mitzva lehannichah bitchillat shelish haelyon, verav huna amar: magbiah min hakkarka tefach, umarchik min hakkora tefach, vechol happetach kullo kasher limzuza.

Metivi: magbiah min hakkarka tefach, umarchik min hakkora tefach, vechol happetach kullo kasher limzuza, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: "ukeshartam" "uchetavtam", ma keshira begova – af ketiva begova.
Bishlama lerav huna, hu deamar kerabbi yehuda, ella lishmuel deamar – keman? lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose!
Amar rav huna bereh derav natan: leolam kerabbi yose,
b: Umay techillat shelish haelyon deka amar? leharechikah (shello leharechikah min hakkora shel mala yoter mishshelish).
Amar rava: mitzva lehannichah betefach hassamuch lirshut harabbim. may tama? rabbanan amri: kede sheyyifga bammezuza miyyad. rav chanina missura omer: ki hechi detintereh.

Amar rabbi chanina: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam, middat basar vadam – melech yoshev mibbifnim veam meshammerin oto mibbachutz, middat hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, avadav yoshvin mibbifnim vehu meshammeran mibbachutz, shenneemar: "Adonai shomrecha Adonai tzillecha al yad yeminecha".

Daresh rav yosef bereh derava mishshemeh derava: heemik lah tefach – pesula. lema mesayyeya leh: hannicha befatztzin, o shettala aleha malben, im yesh sham tefach – tzarich mezuza acheret, im lav – eno tzarich mezuza acheret.
Ki tanya hahi, befetach sheachore haddelet.
Ha behedya katane la: petach sheachore haddelet, im yesh sham tefach – tzarich mezuza acheret, veim lav – eno tzarich mezuza acheret! ketzad katane.

Tana: heemid lah malben shel kanim, chotech shefoferet umannichah. amar rav acha bereh derava: lo shanu ella sheheemid ulevassof chatach vehinnichah, aval chatach vehinniach ulevassof heemid – pesula, "taase" velo min heasuy.
Veamar rava: hane pitche shimae peturin min hammezuza. may pitche shimae? peligi ba rav richumi veabba yose, chad amar: delet lehu tikra, vechad amar: delet lehu shekofe.
Amar rabba bar shela, amar rav chisda: achsadra petura min hammezuza, lefi sheen lah patztzimin. ha yesh lah patztzimin chayyayv? lechizzuk tikra hu daavidi!

Hachi kaamar: af al pi sheyyesh lah patztzimin – petura, sheen asuyin ella lechizzuk lattikra. amar abbaye: chazena lehu leispelidi deve mar, deit lehu patztzime velet lehu mezuzata. kasavar: lechizzuk tikra hu daavidi.
Metivi: bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset – chayyayvin bimzuza! beachsadra deve rav. achsadra deve rav keinderona meallayyta hu! beachsadra romyata.
Amar rachava, amar rav yehuda: be harezike chayyayv bishte mezuzot. may be harezike? amar rav pappa sava mishshemeh derav: bet shaar happatuach lechatzer, uvattim petuchin levet shaar.

Tanu rabbanan: bet shaar happatuach leginna ulekitonit – rabbi yose omer: niddon kekitonit, vachachamim omrim: niddon kevet shaar. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: migginna levayit – kulle alma la peligi dechayyayv, may tama? bia devayit hi.
Ki peligi mibbayit leginna, mar savar: kitonit ikkar, umar savar: ginna ikkar.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: mibbayit leginna, dechulle alma la peligi defatur. may tama? pitcha deginna hu. ki peligi – migginna levayit, mar savar: bia devayit hu, umar savar: kulla

a: Addata deginna hu daavida.
Abbaye verava avdi kerabba verav yosef, verav ashe aved kerav ushemuel lechumera, vehilcheta kerav ushemuel lechumera.

Ittemar: lul patuach min habbayit laaliyyay, amar rav huna: im yesh lo petach echad – chayyayv bimzuza achat, im yesh lo shene petachin – chayyayv bishte mezuzot. amar rav pappa: shema minna midderav huna, hay inderona deit leh arbea bave – chayyayv bearba mezuzot. peshita! la tzericha, af al gav dirgil bechad.
Amar ammemar: hay pitcha deakkarna chayyayv bimzuza. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha let leh patztzimin! amar leh: ade patztzime.

Rav pappa ikkela leve mar shemuel, chaza hahu pitcha dela hava leh ella (patztzim echad) [chad patztzima] missemala, vaavida leh mezuza. amar leh: keman? kerabbi meir? emar deamar rabbi meir miyyamin, missemol mi amar?

May hi? detanya: "betecha" – "biatcha", min hayyamin. atta omer min hayyamin, o eno ella missemol? talmud lomar: "betecha". may talmuda? amar rabba: derech biatcha min hayyamin, dechi akar inish kareh deyammina akar.

Rav shemuel bar acha kammeh derav pappa mishshemeh derava bar ulla amar, mehacha: "vayyikkach yehoyada hakkohen aron echad vayyikkov chor bedalto vayyitten oto etzel hammizbeach miyyamin bevo ish bet Adonai venatnu shamma hakkohanim shomre hassaf et kol hakkesef hammuva vet Adonai".
May rabbi meir? detanya: bayit sheen lo ella patztzim echad, rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza, vachachamim potrin. may tama derabbanan? "mezuzot" ketiv.

May tama derabbi meir? detanya: "mezuzot" – shomea ani miut mezuzot shetayim, keshehu omer "mezuzot" befarasha sheniyya, sheen talmud lomar, have ribbuy achar ribbuy, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet, miato hakkatuv limzuza achat, divre rabbi yishmael.

Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, keshehu omer: "al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot", sheen talmud lomar "shete", ma talmud lomar "shete"? ze bana av, kol makom shenneemar "mezuzot" eno ella achat, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv shetayim.
Tanu rabbanan: "uchetavtam" – yachol yichtevenna al haavanim? neemar kan ketiva, veneemar lehallan ketiva – ma lehallan al hassefer, af kan al hassefer.
O kelach lederech zo: neemar kan ketiva, veneemar lehallan ketiva, ma lehallan al haavanim, af kan al haavanim!

Nire lemi dome? danin ketiva hannoheget ledorot mikketiva hannoheget ledorot, veen danin ketiva hannoheget ledorot mikketiva sheenah noheget ledorot, uchemo shenneemar lehallan: "vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al hassefer baddeyo".
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: rachamana amar "al mezuzot", veat amrat nelaf ketiva ketiva? amar kera "uchetavtam" – ketiva tamma, vahadar "al hammezuzot".
Umeachar dichtiv ["uchetavtam"], hay gezera shava lema li? i lav gezera shava, hava amena lichteva aavna velikbea assippa, ka mashma lan.
Arba parashiyyot shebbattefillin meakkevot zo et zo, vaafillu ketav echad meakkevan. peshita!

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: lo nitzrecha ella lekotzo shel yud. veha name peshita! lo nitzrecha ella leiddach derav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ot sheen gevil mukkaf lah mearba ruchoteha, pesula.
b: Tanu rabbanan: "letotefet" "letotefet" "letotafot" – hare kan arba, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, "tat" bechatpi shetayim, "pat" beafriki shetayim.

Tanu rabbanan: yachol yichtevem al arbaa orot, veyannichem bearbaa battim bearbaa orot? talmud lomar: "ulezikkaron ben enecha", zikkaron echad amarti lach, velo shenayim ushelosha zichronot. ha ketzad? kotvan al arbaa orot umannichan bearbaa battim beor echad.

Veim ketavan beor echad, vehinnichan bearbaa battim – yatza, vetzarich sheyyehe revach benehen, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich. veshavin, shennoten chut o meshicha ben kol achat veachat. veim en charitzan nikkar – pesulot.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad kotvan? tefilla shel yad kotvah al or echad, veim ketavah bearba orot vehinnicha bevayit echad – yatza. vetzarich ledabbek, shenneemar: "vehaya lecha leot al yadcha", keshem sheot achat mibbachutz – kach ot achat mibbifnim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: eno tzarich.

Amar rabbi yose: umode li rabbi yehuda beribbi, sheim en lo tefillin shel yad veyesh lo shete tefillin shel rosh, shettole or al achat mehen umannichah. mode? hayeynu pelugetayyhu! amar rava: middevarav shel rabbi yose chazar bo rabbi yehuda.
Ini? veha shelach rav chananya mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: tefilla shel yad osin otah shel rosh, veshel rosh en osin otah shel yad, lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla.
La kashya, ha beattikata, ha bechadtata. uleman deamar hazemana milleta hi, deatni alayyhu meikkara.
Tanu rabbanan: ketzad sidran? "kaddesh li" "vehaya ki yeviacha" miyyamin, "shema" "vehaya im shamoa" missemol.
Vehatanya ippecha? amar abbaye: la kashya, kan mimino shel kore, kan mimino shel manniach, vehakkore kore kesidran.
Amar rav chananel amar rav: hechlif parashiyyoteha pesulot. amar abbaye: la amaran

a: Ella gavvayyta levarayyta uvarayyta legavvayyta, aval gavvayyta legavvayyta uvarayyta levarayyta – let lan ba.

Amar leh rava: may shena gavvayyta levarayyta uvarayyta legavvayyta dela, dehach devae lemichze avvera la ka chazyay, veha dela ka vae lemichze avvera ka chazyay? barayyta levarayyta vegavvayyta legavvayyta name – hach devaaya lemichze avvera deyamin ka chazya avvera dismol, vedismol ka chazya avvera deyamin! ella la shena.
Veamar rav chananel, amar rav: tittura ditfillin halacha lemoshe missinay. amar abbaye: mabarta ditfillin halacha lemoshe missinay. veamar abbaye: shin shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay.
Vetzarich sheyyaggia charitz limkom hattefer, rav dimi minnehardea amar: kevan deminnechar, la tzerich.
Veamar abbaye: hay kilpa ditfillin tzarich lemivdekeh, dedilma it ba reuta, uvaena ketiva tamma velekka. rav dimi minnehardea amar: la tzerich, kulemosa badek la.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: retzuot shechorot halacha lemoshe missinay. metivi: tefillin en koshrin otan ella beminan, ben yerukkot ben shechorot ben levanot, adummot lo yaase, mippene genay vedavar acher.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase betalmido shel rabbi akiva shehaya kosher tefillav bilshonot shel techelet, vela amar lo davar. ifshar oto tzaddik raa talmido velo micha bo? amar lo: hen, lo raa oto, veim raa oto lo haya mannicho.

Maase behurekanos beno shel rabbi eliezer ben hurekanos, shehaya kosher tefillav bilshonot shel argaman, velo amar lo davar. ifshar oto tzaddik raa beno velo micha bo? amru lo: hen, lo raa oto, veim raa oto lo haya mannicho.
Katane miha, ben yerukkot ben shechorot uven levanot. la kashya: kan – mibbifnim, kan – mibbachutz.
I mibbifnim, may genay vedavar acher ikka? zimnin demithafchin leh.
Tana: tefillin merubbaot – halacha lemoshe missinay. amar rav pappa: betifran uvaalachsonan.
Lema mesayyay leh: haose tefillato agulla – sakkana veen bah mitzva. amar rav pappa: matnitin daavida ki amguza.
Amar rav huna: tefillin, kol zeman sheppene tavla kayyemet – kesherot. rav chisda amar: nifseku shetayim – kesherot, shalosh – pesulot.
Amar rava: ha deamrat shetayim kesherot, la amaran ella ze shello keneged ze, aval ze keneged ze – pesulot. veze keneged ze name la amaran ella bechadtata, aval beattikata let lan ba.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hechi damyayn chadtata, vehechi damyayn attikata? amar leh: kol hecha ki mittele beh beshilcha vahadar chalem – attikata, veiddach – chadtata.
b: Vei name kol hechi dechi mittele beh bemitna atyeh abbatreh – chadtata, veiddach – attikata.
Abbaye hava yatev kammeh derav yosef, ippesik leh retzua ditfille, amar leh: mahu lemiktereh? amar leh: "ukeshartam" ketiv, shettehe keshira tamma.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: mahu lemitpereh veayyoyleh litfira legav? amar: pok chazi ma amma davar.

Amar rav pappa: gardumme retzuot kesherot, velav milleta hi, middeamri bene rabbi chiyyay: gardumme techelet vegardumme ezov kesherin. hatam hu detashmishe mitzva ninhu, aval hacha detashmishe kedushsha ninhu – la.
Mikkelal deit lehu shiura, vechamma shiurayyhu? amar rame bar chama amar resh lakish: ad etzba tzereda. rav kahana machve kafuf, rav ashe machve pashut.
Rabba katar lehu ufashet veshade lehu, rav acha bar yaakov katar lehu umetallet lehu, mar bereh deravna aved kedidan.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: kesher shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay. amar rav nachman: venoyehen levar. rav ashe hava yatev kammeh demar zutera, ithafcha leh retzua ditfillin. amar leh: la savar la mar venoyehen levar? amar leh: lav addatay.

"Verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka", tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh. "vahasiroti et kappi veraita et achoray", amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: melammed shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe kesher shel tefillin.
Amar rav yehuda: kesher shel tefillin tzarich sheyyehe lemala, kede sheyyehu yisrael lemala velo lematta, vetzarich sheyyehe kelappe panim, kede sheyyehu yisrael lefanim velo leachor.

Amar rav shemuel bar bedare amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi acha aricha amar rav huna, veamri la amar rav menashsheya amar shemuel: tefillin meematay mevarech alehen? mishsheat hannachatan. ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan! abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mishsheat hannacha vead sheat keshira.

a: Amar rav chisda: sach ben tefilla litfilla chozer umevarech.

Sach – in, lo sach – la? veha shelach rav chiyyay bereh derav huna mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: al tefilla shel yad omer "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin", al tefillin shel rosh omer "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin".
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: lo sach – mevarech achat, sach – mevarech shetayim.
Tana: sach ben tefilla litfilla – avera hi beyado, vechozer aleha meerche hammilchama.

Tana: keshehu manniach – manniach shel yad, veachar kach manniach shel rosh, ucheshehu choletz – choletz shel rosh, veachar kach choletz shel yad. bishlama keshehu manniach – manniach shel yad veachar kach manniach shel rosh, dichtiv: "ukeshartam leot al yadecha", vahadar "vehayu letotafot ben enecha".
Ella keshehu choletz, choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad, menalan? amar rabba: rav huna asbera li, amar kera: "vehayu letotafot ben enecha", kol zeman shebben enecha yehu shetayim.

Tanu rabbanan: tefillin meematay mevarech alehen? mishsheat hannachatan. ketzad? haya mashkim latzet ladderech umityayre shemma yovedu – mannichan, uchesheyyaggia zemannan memashmesh bahen umevarech alehen.

Vead matay mannichan? ad shettishka hachamma. rabbi yaakov omer: ad shettichle regel min hashshuk, vachachamim omrim: ad zeman shena. umodim chachamim lerabbi yaakov sheim chalatzan latzet levet hakkisse o likkanes levet hammerchatz veshaka chamma – shuv eno chozer umannichan.
Amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi yaakov. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna metzallu behu beureta. ikka deamri: en halacha kerabbi yaakov.
b: Veha rav chisda verabba bar rav huna metzallu behu beureta? hahu peliga.
Umi amar rabba bar rav huna hachi? veha amar rabba bar rav huna: safek chashecha safek (la) [en] chashecha – lo choletz velo manniach, ha vadday chashecha – choletz! hatam beerev shabbat ittemar.
May kasavar? i kasavar layla zeman tefillin, shabbat name zeman tefillin. i kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefillin, layla name lav zeman tefillin, demehecha demimmaata shabbat mehatam mimmaati lelot.

Detanya: "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima" – "yamim" velo lelot, "miyyamim" velo kol yamim, perat leshabbatot veyamim tovim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: lo neemra chukka zo ella lefesach bilvad.

Nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi akiva, detanya: rabbi akiva omer: yachol yanniach adam tefillin beshabbatot uveyamim tovim? talmud lomar: "vehaya leot al yadcha uletotafot ben enecha" – mi shetztzerichin ot, yatzu shabbatot veyamim tovim shehen gufan ot.

Amar rabbi elazar: kol hammanniach tefillin achar shekiat hachamma over baase, verabbi yochanan amar: over belav. lema berabbi avin amar rabbi ila ka mippalgi, deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer" "pen" veal" eno ella lo taase.
Demar it leh derabbi avin, umar let leh derabbi avin.
La, dechulle alma it lehu derabbi avin amar rabbi ila, vehacha beha ka mippalgi: mar savar "hishshamer" delav – lav, vehishshamer" daase – ase, umar savar "hishshamer" daase name lav.

Veamar rabbi elazar: veim leshomran – muttar. veamar ravina: hava yatevna kammeh derav ashe vechashach, vehinniach tefillin, vaamari leh: leshomran ka vae lehu mar? vaamar li: in. vachazeteh ledateh delav leshomran hu bae, kasavar: halacha veen morin ken.

Amar rabba bar rav huna: chayyayv adam lemashmesh battefillin bechol shaa, kal vachomer mitztzitz, uma tzitz sheen bo ella azkara achat, amra tora: "vehaya al mitzcho tamid", shello (tassiach) [yassiach] dato mimmennu, tefillin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harebe, al achat kamma vechamma!

Tanu rabbanan: "yadcha" – zo semol. atta omer semol, o eno ella yamin? talmud lomar: "af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim", veomer: "yadah layyated tishlachna viminah lehalemut amelim", veomer: "lamma tashiv yadcha viminecha mikkerev chekcha challe".

a: Rabbi yose hachoram omer: matzinu yamin shennikra yad, shenneemar: "vayyar yosef ki yashit aviv yad yemino". veiddach – "yad yemino" ikkeri, "yad" setama la ikkeri.

Rabbi natan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "ukeshartam" "uchetavtam" – ma ketiva beyamin, af keshira beyamin, vechevan dikshira beyamin – hannacha bismol hi. verabbi yose hachoram, hannacha devismol mena leh? nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi natan.
Rav ashe amar: miyyadcha" ketiv, behe keha. amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: veema "yadcha" shebbechoach? amar leh: mi ketiv bechet?
Ketannae: "yadcha" behe – zo semol, acherim omrim: "yadcha" lerabbot et haggiddem. tanya iddach: en lo zeroa – patur min hattefillin, acherim omrim: "yadcha" lerabbot et haggiddem.
Tanu rabbanan: itter manniach tefillin bimino, shehu semolo. vehatanya: manniach bismolo shehu semolo shel kol adam! amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi besholet bishte yadav.
Tana deve menashshe: "al yadcha" – zo kibboret, "ben enecha" – zo kodkod. hecha? amri deve rabbi yannay: mekom shemmocho shel tinok rofes.

Bea minneh pelemo merabbi: mi sheyyesh lo shene rashim, beeze mehen manniach tefillin? amar leh: o kum geli, o kabbel alach shamta. addehachi ata hahu gavra, amar leh: ityelid li yanoka deit leh tere reshe, kamma baena lemittav lechohen? ata hahu sava tena leh: chayyayv litten lo asara selaim.
Ini? vehatane rame bar chama: mittoch shenneemar "pado tifde et bechor haadam", shomea ani afillu nitraf betoch sheloshim, talmud lomar
b: "Ach" – chillek, shane hacha divgulegolet tela rachamana.

Amar mar: "yadcha" zo kibboret, menalan? detanu rabbanan: "al yadcha" – zo gova shebbayyad. atta omer: zo gova shebbayyad, o eno ella al yadcha mammash? amra tora: hannach tefillin bayyad vehannach tefillin barosh, ma lehallan begova shebbarosh – af kan begova shebbayyad.

Rabbi eliezer omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vehaya lecha leot", lecha leot velo laacherim leot. rabbi yitzchak omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vesamtem et devaray elle al levavchem ... ukeshartam", shettehe sima keneged hallev.

Rabbi chiyyay verav acha bereh derav avya mechavven umannach leh lahade libbeh. rav ashe hava yatev kammeh deammemar, hava tzirya bideh veka mitchazyayn tefillin. amar leh: la savar la mar "lecha leot" velo laacherim leot? amar leh: bimkom "lecha leot" ittemar.

Gova shebbarosh, menalan? detanu rabbanan: "ben enecha" – zo gova shebbarosh. atta omer zo gova shebbarosh, o eno ella ben enecha mammash? neemar kan "ben enecha", veneemar lehallan "lo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet". ma lehallan begova shebbarosh, mekom sheose korcha – af kan begova shel rosh, mekom sheose korcha.
Rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich, amra tora: "hannach tefillin bayyad", "hannach tefillin barosh", ma lehallan bemakom harauy littame benega echad, af kan bemakom harauy littame benega echad.
Leappoke "ben enecha", deikka basar vesear, deikka sear lavan, veikka name sear tzahov.
Arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo, shearbatan mitzva achat. may benayyhu? amar rav yosef: sadin betzitzit ikka benayyhu.
Rava bar ahina amar: tallit baalat chamesh ikka benayyhu.
Ravina amar: derav huna ikka benayyhu, deamar rav huna: hayyotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilchatah beshabbat – chayyayv chattat.
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: hay man devatztzereh liglimeh – la avad velo kelum, shavveyeh tallit baalat chamesh.
Amar rav mesharsheya: hay man detzayyeyreh liglimeh – la avad velo kelum. may tama? dichman desharyeh dame. utenan name: kol chamatot hatztzerurot tehorot, chutz mishshel arviyyim.
Amar rav dimi minnehardea: hay man dechayyeyteh liglimeh – la avad velo kelum, im ita dela mibbee leh – lifsok velishdeyeh.
Rabbi yishmael omer: arbatan arba mitzvot. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yishmael, velet hilcheta kevateh.

Ravina hava ka azel abbatreh demar bar rav ashe beshabbeta derigla, ippesik karna dechuteh, vela amar leh vela midde. kad meta leveteh, amar leh: mehatam ippesik. amar leh: i amart li mehatam shedeteh.
Veha amar mar: gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora?
Targevma rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana,

a: Belav delo tasur".

Veikka deamri mehatam amar leh, vaamar leh: may dataych lemishdeyeh? vehaamar mar: gadol kevod haveriyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora! veha targevma rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana belav delo tasur", hacha name karmelit derabbanan hi.
Hadaran alach hakkometz.
Mishna hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan, vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet. tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet et shel rosh, veshel rosh enah meakkevet et shel yad.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi, detanya: "ureitem oto" – melammed shemmeakkevin ze et ze, divre rabbi, vachachamim omrim: en meakkevin.
May tama derabbi? dichtiv "hakkanaf" – min kanaf, uchetiv "petil techelet", veamar rachamana "ureitem oto" – ad deikka tarvayyhu bechad.
Verabbanan, "ureitem oto" – kol chad lechodeh mashma.
Lema dela kerabbi? amar rav yehuda amar rav: afillu tema rabbi, lo nitzrecha ella lekaddem.
Detanya: mitzva lehakedim lavan lattechelet, veim hikdim techelet lallavan – yatza, ella shechisser mitzva. may chisser mitzva?
b: Illema chisser mitzva delavan vekiyyem mitzva ditchelet – lerabbi akkove meakkev ahadade.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shechisser mitzva veasa mitzva, umay chisser mitzva? dela avad mitzva min hammuvechar.
Hatinach lavan deeno meakkev et hattechelet, techelet deenah meakkevet et hallavan – may hi?
Amar rame bar chama: lo nitzrecha ella letallit shekkullah techelet.

Ittemar name: amar leh levi lishmuel: aryoch, la tittev akkarach ad dimfarshat li leha milleta: hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan, vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet – may hi? amar leh: lo nitzrecha ella lesadin betzitzit, demitzva leakdome lavan beresha.
May tama? "hakkanaf" – min kanaf, vei akdem techelet lelavan – let lan ba.
Tinach lavan deeno meakkev et hattechelet, techelet deenah meakkevet et hallavan may hi?
Amar leh rame bar chama: lo nitzrecha ella letallit shekkullah techelet, demitzva leakdome techelet beresha, dehakkanaf" – min kanaf, vei akdem lavan beresha let lan ba.
Amar rava: midde tziva ka garem? ella amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella legardummin, dei iggardam techelet vekae lavan, vei iggardam lavan vekae techelet – let lan ba.
Deamri bene rabbi chiyyay: gardumme techelet kesherin, vegardumme ezov kesherin. vechamma shiur gardummin? amar bar hamedure amar shemuel: kede leonvan.
Ibbaya lehu: kede leonvan – leonvan kullehu bahadade, o dilma kol chad vechad lechodeh? teku.
Bae rav ashe: allime dela mianvi, vei havo kattine mianvi, may? amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kol shekken deminnechar mitzvatayyhu.

Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi? hay tanna hu, detanya: rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi natan, sheamar mishshum rabbi yose haggelili, sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan ben nuri: en lo techelet – metil lavan.

Amar rava: shema minna, tzarich likshor al kol chuleya vechuleya, dei salka datach lo tzarich – ha deamri bene rabbi chiyyay: gardumme techelet kesherin vegardumme ezov kesherin, kevan deishteri leh illay ishteri leh kulle.

a: Dilma deikketar.
Veamar rabba: shema minna, kesher elyon deorayyta, dei salka datach derabbanan, may itzterich lemishre sadin betzitzit? peshita! hattochef techifa achat eno chibbur, ella shema minna deorayyta.

Amar rabba bar rav adda amar rav adda amar rav: im nifsak hachut meikkaro – pesula. yatev rav nachman veka amar leha shemata, etiveh rava lerav nachman: bamme devarim amurim – bitchillato, aval sofo – sheyarav vegardummav kol shehu.
May sheyarav umay gardummav? may lav "sheyarav" – deippesik minnayyhu veishtayyayr minnayyhu, "gardummav" – deiggardum iggardome.
La, chada katane, shayyore gardummav kol shehu. velema: "gardummav", "sheyarav" lema li? ha ka mashma lan, devaenan shiyyura legardummav kede leonvan.

Yatev rabba vekaamar mishshemeh derav: chut shel kerech ole min hamminyan. amar leh rav yosef: shemuel amra vela rav. ittemar name: amar rabba bar bar chana, sach li rabbi yoshiyya demin usha: chut shel kerech ola lah min hamminyan.

Yatev rava veka amar mishshemeh dishmuel: techelet shekkarach rubbah – keshera. amar leh rav yosef: rav amra, vela shemuel. ittemar name, amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: techelet shekkarach rubbah – keshera.

Rav chiyyay bereh derav natan matne hachi: amar rav huna, amar rav sheshet, amar rav yirmeya bar abba, amar rav: techelet shekkarach rubbah – keshera, vaafillu lo karach bah ella chuleya achat – keshera, venoye techelet – shelish gedil ushene shelishe anaf.
Vechamma shiur chuleya? tanya, rabbi omer: kede sheyyichroch veyishne vishallesh. tana: happochet lo yifchot mishsheva, vehammosif lo yosif al shelosh esre.
