Happochet lo yifchot mishsheva, keneged shiva rekiim, vehammosif lo yosif al shelosh esre, keneged shiva rekiin veshishsha avirin shebbenehem.
Tana: keshehu matchil – matchil ballavan: "hakkanaf" – min kanaf, ucheshehu mesayyem – mesayyem ballavan, maalin bakkodesh velo moridin.
Rav verabba bar bar chana havo yatvi, hava ka chalef veazel hahu gavra demikkasse gelima dechulle techelta, ureme leh techelta
b: Ugedila miggedil. amar rav: yae gelima vela yae techelta, rabba bar bar chana amar: yae gelima veyae techelta.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabba bar bar channa savar: ketiv "gedil" uchetiv "petil", o gedil o fetil.
Verav savar: leolam petil baenan, vehahu "gedilim" leminyayna hu daata – gedil shenayim, gedilim arbaa, ase gedil ufotlehu mittocho.
Amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi: chute tzemer potrin beshel pishtan.
Ibbaya lehu: shel pishtan mahu sheyyifteru beshel tzemer? tzemer beshel pishtim hu defatar, dechevan ditchelet patra lavan name patar, aval pishtim betzemer la.
O dilma, kevan dichtiv: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav. gedilim taase lach", la shena tzemer befishtim vela shena pishtim betzemer?
Ta shema, deamar rachava amar rav yehuda: chute tzemer potrin beshel pishtan, veshel pishtan potrin beshel tzemer, chute tzemer ufishtim potrin bechol makom, vaafillu beshirain.
Ufeliga derav nachman, deamar rav nachman: hashshirain peturin min hatztzitzit. etiveh rava lerav nachman: hashshirain vehakkalach vehasserikin kullan chayyayvin betzitzit – midderabbanan.

I hachi, ema sefa: vechullan tzemer ufishtim potrin bahen. i amrat bishlama deorayyta – hayeynu demishteru behu kilayim, ella i amrat derabbanan – hechi mishtere behu kilayim? ema: o tzemer o pishtim.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: hen beminan potrin, shello beminan en potrin. i amrat bishlama derabbanan – hayeynu demippatru beminan, ella i amrat deorayyta – tzemer ufishtim hu defatar.
I mishshum ha la irya, kidrava, derava rame: ketiv "hakkanaf" – min kanaf, uchetiv "tzemer ufishtim".
Ha ketzad? tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan, shear minin – beminan potrin, shello beminan en potrin.
Verav nachman, kidtana deve rabbi yishmael.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veneemru begadim battora setam, ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim – af kol tzemer ufishtim.

Amar abbaye: vehay tana deve rabbi yishmael mappeka meiddach tana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "beged" – en li ella beged tzemer, minnayin lerabbot tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim venotza shel izzim vehakkalach vehasserikin vehashshirain minnayin? talmud lomar: "o veged".

a: Tanu rabbanan: sadin betzitzit – bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayyeyvin, vahalacha kedivre bet hillel.
Amar rabbi eliezer ben rabbi tzadok: vahalo kol hammetil techelet birushalayim eno ella min hammatmihin!
Amar rabbi: im ken, lamma asaruha? lefi sheen bekiin.
Amar leh rava bar rav chana lerava: velirmo be asra venippeku leshuka umipparsema (lemilleta) [milleta]! kol shekken dematmehu illavan.
Velidresha befirka! gezera mishshum kala ilan.
Velo yehe ella lavan! kevan deefshar beminan – la.
Kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem – mutav, veim lav – yavo ase veyidche et lo taase.
Velivdekuha, ella gezera mishshum teima.
Velichteva addiske! addiske lekum velismoch? amar rava: hasheta
b: Chametz befesach veyom hakkippurim decharet – samchinan addiske, hacha daase bealma lo kol shekken!
Ella amar rava: ha milleta amri, veittemar bemareva mishshum derabbi zera kevavti: shemma yikkara sedino betoch shalosh veyitperennu.
Vehattora amra: "taase" – velo min heasuy.
Shera rabbi zera lisdineh. rav zera amar: gezera name mishshum kesut layla.

Veamar rava: ha milleta amari, veittemar bemareva mishshemeh derabbi zera kevavti: hi shel beged uchenafeha shel or – chayyevet, hi shel or uchenafeha shel beged – petura. may tama? ikkar beged baenan.
Rav achay azel batar kanaf.
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: hetil levaalat shalosh, vehishlimah learba – pesula, "taase" – velo min heasuy.
Metivi: chasidim harishonim, kevan sheargu bah shalosh, hayu metilin lah techelet. ema: kevan sheppatzu bah shalosh, hayu metilin lah techelet.
Umi amrinan "taase" – velo min heasuy? (ini), vehaamar rabbi zera: hetil lemuttelet – keshera.
Amar rava: hasheta beval tosif" kae, maase la have?
Matkef la rav pappa: mimmay degavra leosofe ka mikkavven? dilma levattole ka mikkavven, uval tosif" lekka, maase ikka!
Amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar shemuel: techelet en bah mishshum kilayim, vaafillu betallit petura.
May tallit petura? illema delet ba shiura, vehatanya: tallit shehakkatan mitkasse bo rosho verubbo

a: Vehaggadol yotze bah derech aray – chayyevet betzitzit, en hakkatan mitkasse bo rosho verubbo, af al pi shehaggadol yotze bah aray – petura, vechen leinyan kilayim.
Vehavenan ba: may "vechen leinyan kilayim"? illema vechen leinyan issura dechilayim, veha anan tenan: en aray bechilayim!
Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vechen leinyan sadin betzitzit.
Ella may petura – hetil lammutelet.
Veha amra rabbi zera chada zimna? chada mikkelal dachavertah ittemar.
Tanu rabbanan: tallit kefula chayyevet betzitzit, verabbi shimon poter, veshavin sheim kefalah utefarah – shechayyevet.
Tefarah, peshita! la tzericha denakta besikke.
Rabba bar huna ikkela leve rava bar rav nachman, chazyeh dahava mikkasse tallit kefula, ureme leh chute illave kefela. ippeshita, vaata chuta vekam lahade resheh.
Amar leh: lav hayeynu kanaf dichtav rachamana beorayyta! ata shadyay, ikkassi gelima achariti.
Amar leh: mi savrat chovat gavra hu? chovat tallit hu, zil remi la.
Lema mesayyay leh: chasidim harishonim, kevan sheargu bah shalosh – hayu metilin bah techelet. shane chasidim, demachmeri annafshayyhu.
Ufeliga demalacha, demalacha ashkecheh lerav kattina demikkasse sedina, amar leh: kattina, kattina! sedina bekayyta vesarbala besitva, tzitzit shel techelet ma tehe aleha?
Amar leh: anshitu aase? amar leh: bizman deikka ritcha anshinan.
I amrat bishlama chovat gavra hu – hayeynu demichayyayv dela ka rame, ella i amrat chovat tallit hu – ha la michayyeyva!
Ella may chovat gavra hu? nehi dechayyeyveh rachamana ki mikkasse tallit devat chiyyuva, ki mikkasse tallit delav bat chiyyuva hi, mi chayyeyveh rachamana?
Ella hachi kaamar leh: tatzdeke lemiftar nafshach mitztzitzit?
Amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: kele kufesa chayyayvin betzitzit, umode shemuel bezaken sheasaah lichvodo sheppetura. may tama? "asher techasse bah" amar rachamana, hay lav leikkassoye avida.
Behahi shata, vadday ramenan leh, mishshum "loeg larash cheref osehu".
Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda: tallit shennikrea chutz leshalosh – yitpor, toch shalosh – lo yitpor.
Tanya name hachi: tallit shennikrea, chutz leshalosh – yitpor, toch shalosh – rabbi meir omer: lo yitpor, vachachamim omrim: yitpor.
Veshavin shello yavi afillu amma al amma mimmakom acher uvah techelet, vetole bah. veshavin shemmevi techelet mimmakom acher vetole bah,
b: Uvilvad shello tehe mufeseket. shamat minna mattirin mibbeged leveged? dilma dei belay.
Tanu rabbanan: tallit shekkullah techelet – kol mine tzivonin potrin bah, chutz mikkala ilan.
Metivi: tallit en poter bah ella minah. tallit shekkullah techelet – mevi techelet vedavar acher vetole bah, vekala ilan lo yavi, veim hevi – kasher.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: la kashya, kan betallit bat arbaa chutin, kan betallit bat shemona chutin.
Shamat minna mattirin mibbeged leveged? dilma dei avad.
Ittemar, rav amar: en mattirin mibbeged leveged, ushemuel amar: mattirin mibbeged leveged.
Rav amar: en madlikin minner lener, ushemuel amar: madlikin minner lener.
Rav amar: en halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira.
Amar abbaye: kol mille demar aved kerav, levar mehane telat deaved kishmuel: mattirin mibbeged leveged, umadlikin minner lener, vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira.
Detanya, rabbi shimon omer: gorer adam mitta, kisse vesafsal, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz.
Rav yehuda masar leh lekatztzara, rav chanina aved le sisa, ravina chayet lehu mechat.
Tanu rabbanan: kamma chutin hu noten? bet shammay omrim: arbaa, uvet hillel omrim: shelosha.

Vechamma tehe meshulleshet? bet shammay omrim: arba, uvet hillel omrim: shalosh. veshalosh shebbet hillel omrim, achat mearba betefach shel kol adam. amar rav pappa: tefach deorayyta arba begudal, shet biktanna, chamesh betilta.
Amar rav huna: arbaa betoch arba, umeshulleshet arba, verav yehuda amar: shelosha betoch shalosh, meshulleshet shalosh.
Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: arbaa betoch shalosh, meshulleshet arba.

Lememra deit lehu shiura, ureminhu: "tzitzit" – en tzitzit ella yotze, veen tzitzit ella mashshehu, uchevar alu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel laaliyyayt yochanan ben betira, veamru: tzitzit en lah shiur; kayyotze bo, lulav en bo shiur.
May lav en lah shiur kelal? la,
